baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked verbs at words 3, 5, 7, and 11 move from dispatch through stirring and driving to revival, ending at word 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: A released atmospheric agent mobilizes a drawn carrier, drives it to a bounded nonliving recipient, and transfers life there. The shifts of subject preserve a relay of real mediating causes under divine initiation rather than collapsing the event into an instantaneous result.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch supply the initiating handoff and distinguish sending from continued holding.
Moving air supplies the mobile agent that can act at a distance from the eventual recipient.
Dislodging and setting something in motion supplies the transition from latent material to an active carrier.
Dragging and extending supply the carrier's drawn-out movement across space.
Driving a mobile body toward a destination gives the relay direction rather than random diffusion.
A delimited tract of earth supplies a concrete recipient with a boundary and destination.
Rain-enabled vegetal life supplies the observable transfer outcome at the end of the relay.
Reviving the dead identifies the whole mediated sequence as a mechanism-bearing analogue of resurrection.

changed_reading.before: Rain revives dead land and therefore illustrates resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection is rendered as a coordinated relay of release, mobilization, directed conveyance, reception, and quickening, so mediation is part of the analogy rather than incidental scenery.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of the death root at words 10 and 15 surround revival at word 11, while the temporal term at word 14 explicitly marks an after-state.
baseline_models.mechanism: The land is not replaced by an unrelated location: a substrate crosses from lost generative power through an interval into renewed productivity. Dry growth revived by rain keeps dormancy, continuity, and threshold crossing simultaneously visible.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life and effective power defines the initial side of the threshold.
Dead land and spiritless material keep the death predicate materially anchored rather than merely emotional.
A yielding, growth-capable earth supplies the substrate whose capacity can be latent before becoming visible.
Ordered after-versus-before time makes death an interval crossed, not a synonym simply exchanged.
Vegetal quickening by rain supplies restored generative function on the far side of the threshold.
Rain reviving dry herbage joins resurrection to dormant matter becoming productive again.

changed_reading.before: A dead surface turns green again.
changed_reading.after: The same recipient crosses a timed threshold from disabled generativity to renewed life, making continuity through a dead interval central to the resurrection image.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The stirring verb at word 5 has a split mapped inventory, and the closing resurrection noun at word 17 also carries opening, spreading, and publication branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: Stirring brings what was dormant or hidden into manifestation; the split trace branch preserves a remainder of what preceded; the final opening and publication branches make resurrection legible as recovery and exposure of dispersed traces as well as animation.

activation_trace.role: Emergence and visible spread after dormancy supply the disclosure phase of stirring.
A remaining sign of what occurred supplies recoverable continuity across disappearance.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the final movement from enclosure to public extension.
A written record laid open supplies the exploratory sense of resurrection as publication of what had been latent.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection means bodies rise after death.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection may also be pictured as dormant traces being stirred, recovered, spread out, and made legible in public.

context_deltas.mechanism: The weather relay becomes a regulated aperture: origination opens, mercy issues through an outlet, restraint can stop release, and later restraint prevents cosmic displacement. Life-bearing motion therefore depends on calibrated alternation between opening, holding, and release.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch as release anchors the focus chain to the regulated-release mechanism.
Opening by splitting supplies the first aperture through which an originated order can emerge.
Water issuing from an outlet turns the explicit opening into a concrete hydraulic activator for the focus rain sequence.
Merciful tenderness names the beneficial content carried through the opened system.
Holding and confinement provide the valve's opposite state and show that release is controlled.
Cosmic holding extends restraint from mercy's flow to the stability of the transport environment itself.
Movement and disturbance after stillness supply the motion that restraint prevents or permits.

structural_cues: The ordered context first names originating openness, then opposes opening and holding, and much later repeats holding against displacement.
The focus itself changes agents across release, stirring, driving, and reviving, which fits a regulated sequence of gates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: opening, mercy, holding, release, and restrained movement are explicit; inference: they form a valve-like causal system whose released content is instantiated by the focus rain; live alternative: the context may assert sovereignty without specifying any hydraulic analogy.

changed_reading.before: The winds begin a natural transport sequence.
changed_reading.after: The sequence is a calibrated release of mercy in which motion is efficacious precisely because opening and restraint remain under one control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's outward dispatch toward dead land bends into a circuit: the nearby context places sent messengers beside the return of all affairs, while a return branch specifically carries a returning-water image. Resurrection becomes return-to-source through a water-shaped cycle, not only delivery to a terminal point.

activation_trace.role: Outward dispatch supplies the first half of the proposed circuit.
Directed driving gives the outbound movement a definite endpoint from which return can be conceived.
Revival of the dead makes the completed circuit eschatological rather than merely hydrological.
Sent message-bearers parallel the focus dispatch and establish an outward communicative movement.
Returning rain or water supplies the surprising material bridge between universal return and the focus weather process.
Affairs and states supply what completes the return movement rather than leaving it confined to water.

structural_cues: The context verse moves from earlier messenger dispatch to an explicit destination of return.
The focus likewise begins with sending and ends with resurrection, permitting an outbound-inbound reading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: dispatch, the return of affairs, and a returning-water branch are supplied; inference: the rain relay images a larger circulation from God and back to God; live alternative: the water branch may be lexical background while the verse means only eschatological return.

changed_reading.before: Life is sent outward to a dead destination.
changed_reading.after: The outward delivery is one arc of a return circuit, with resurrection completing a movement back to the source of the dispatch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's atmospheric mobilization and downward life-gift acquire a reciprocal upward path: good speech ascends and productive action raises, whereas corrupt plotting becomes barren. The result is a vertical exchange in which received life answers upward with generative yield.

activation_trace.role: Visible emergence and spread supply the focus's atmospheric and vegetal upward activation.
Rain-enabled growth supplies the productive response to what descends.
Literal upward ascent supplies the return vector opposite the life-bearing descent.
The lifting of a crop fuses righteous elevation with the focus's vegetal yield.
Barren empty land supplies the failed counter-output: activity that produces no living yield.

structural_cues: The context immediately after the focus contrasts ascent and raising with a plot that fails to bear fruit.
The focus has already linked atmospheric movement to productive earth, allowing vertical directions to form one exchange.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: ascent, raising, crop-lifting, and barrenness are supplied; inference: descending mercy and ascending good response form a reciprocal ecological-moral circulation; live alternative: the upward and weather sequences may remain separate analogies.

changed_reading.before: Rain descends and produces life below.
changed_reading.after: Life received below becomes an answering upward yield, while corrupt activity is diagnosed as barren rather than merely downward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The weather relay is joined by a second serial life-process: earth-material, a minute fluid beginning, hidden carrying, birth, measured lifespan, and fixed record. Resurrection is thereby modeled as ordered reassembly and maturation through concealed stages, not as an unexplained jump from corpse to completed body.

activation_trace.role: Spiritless land or matter supplies the inert material starting point shared with earth-origin creation.
Rain-mediated growth supplies a staged rather than instantaneous model of becoming alive.
Ordered succession across an interval supplies time for hidden intermediate stages.
Earth and dust supply the material origin that links human formation back to the focus land.
A minute clear fluid extending up to generative seed supplies a compressed living beginning.
Hidden pregnancy and fruit-bearing supply the enclosed maturation stage.
Putting down a carried load in birth supplies emergence from concealed formation.
Life extended through measured time makes maturation and duration part of the created process.
A fixed inscription carrying decree supplies ordered measure rather than spontaneous assembly.

structural_cues: Repeated sequence markers in 35:11 articulate phases from dust to fluid to pairing, gestation, birth, and lifespan.
The focus likewise uses a chain of consecutive clauses and changes agency at successive stages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: two explicit serial processes of material-to-life formation are supplied; inference: the gestational sequence reveals how to read the focus rain sequence as an analogue of staged reassembly; live alternative: the two sequences prove power independently without sharing a process model.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection is an abrupt reversal from dead to alive.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection can be imagined as measured reassembly through hidden and emergent stages, analogous both to rain-growth and gestation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A competing continuity model appears: new creation follows removal, newness occurs after severance, visible bands mark successive layers, and successors stand on the same earth. The revived land may remain the same system while its living constituents and visible forms are replaced in succession.

activation_trace.role: The enduring lower world supplies the stable field across successive living populations.
Dead land supplies a persisting system whose occupants or states can be replaced.
Revival keeps the replacement model anchored to resurrection rather than ordinary historical succession.
Bringing a creation into being supplies the replacement population after removal.
New occurrence after a severance supplies discontinuity within a larger continuity of created order.
Visible tracks and bands supply a geological image of successive layers retained in one landscape.
One party coming after and standing in place of another supplies identity through succession on earth.

structural_cues: Removal followed by new creation precedes the later sequence of visible earth-bands and human successors.
The focus calls the recipient land and earth continuously even though its living state changes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: new creation after removal, layered bands, and successors on earth are supplied; inference: continuity may belong to the created system while its constituents are renewed; live alternative: resurrection may instead require numerical restoration of the same bodies, with succession serving only as a power analogy.

changed_reading.before: Revival restores the same dormant life in the same material substrate.
changed_reading.after: A live alternative is continuity through divinely ordered replacement and succession: the same world becomes alive through newly instantiated forms.

context_deltas.mechanism: A chain of denied equivalences turns life and death from adjacent seasonal states into one of several qualitative thresholds. Divine enabling of hearing across the grave boundary parallels rain-enabled life, so quickening can include restored receptivity and perception without reducing biological resurrection to a metaphor.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life and power anchors the lower category of the threshold.
Life as benefit and active good broadens quickening beyond bare biological persistence.
Raising the dead keeps the qualitative reading tied to actual resurrection.
Comparison and equality supply the explicit relation that the verse then denies across categories.
Blindness of inner perception supplies a non-biological form of disabled receptivity.
Insight supplies the activated counterpart to inner blindness.
Beneficial life makes the explicit living category functionally rich.
Loss of life and efficacy supplies the explicit dead category opposed to the living.
Causing another to hear supplies divine activation of receptivity across an otherwise closed threshold.
Burial of the dead fixes the threshold in literal mortality as well as perception.

structural_cues: Four paired negations run from blind and seeing through darkness and light and shade and heat to living and dead.
The final pair immediately adds divine causing-to-hear and the human inability to make grave-dwellers hear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated non-equivalence, perceptual pairs, living and dead, and caused hearing are supplied; inference: the focus quickening crosses a qualitative receptivity threshold as well as a biological one; live alternative: the pairs may be rhetorical parallels that should not be fused into one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Death and life are successive biological conditions.
changed_reading.after: Quickening is a categorical activation of life, benefit, and receptivity, while the grave language preserves literal death as one irreducible layer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same descending water does not erase distinctions: it brings out fruits of differing kinds and colors, then difference extends through rock, humans, animals, and livestock. The focus revival therefore models individuation under one life-giving input, not a homogeneous return.

activation_trace.role: Growth-capable earth supplies the common recipient from which varied outputs can emerge.
Rain-enabled vegetal life anchors the later water-and-fruit sequence directly in the focus mechanism.
Rain reviving dry growth connects differentiated yield to resurrection.
Delivered descent supplies the common incoming cause.
Water conveyed by pouring or irrigation specifies the life-bearing input left pronominal in the focus.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies emergence of distinct forms from a shared substrate.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the productive output of revived earth.
Divergent paths supply nonidentity among outputs receiving the same water.
Kind or type makes visible color difference function as differentiated identity, not decoration alone.
Acquiring a new color extends differentiated emergence from plants and rocks to living populations.

structural_cues: A single water descent is followed grammatically by plural fruits and repeated difference of colors.
The next verse carries the same difference formula across humans, animals, and livestock before repeating the focus's comparison marker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one water source and many visibly different outputs are supplied; inference: the resurrection analogy includes preservation or re-expression of individual distinctions; live alternative: the variety may demonstrate creative power without describing resurrected identity.

changed_reading.before: One rain event makes dead land generically alive.
changed_reading.after: One life-giving cause elicits a plurality of distinct forms, so resurrection need not flatten identities into an undifferentiated return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's trace and publication branches gain a context-wide mechanism: records are written, the hidden sources of actions remain known, and travel through earth exposes the residual outcomes of predecessors. Resurrection can thus be the opening of an archive in which concealed origins become publicly inspectable consequences.

activation_trace.role: A surviving sign supplies the recoverable datum that persists after its originating event.
A record laid open supplies the publication phase of the archive mechanism.
Writing and authored records supply durable transmitted evidence.
Ordered letters and the written object supply the archive's explicit textual form.
What is screened from sight supplies the archive's concealed layer.
The inner source from which acts issue supplies hidden causation later exposed through consequences.
Movement through the land supplies the procedure for encountering retained evidence.
Directed sight or insight supplies inspection of the archive rather than passive recollection.
A remainder or trace supplies the material residue through which a past outcome can still be read.

structural_cues: Written books recur in 35:25, 35:29, 35:31, and 35:32 before hidden interiors and observable historical outcomes are juxtaposed.
The focus begins with concealed atmospheric matter becoming manifest and ends in a noun that also permits opening a record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: durable writings, hidden sources of action, surviving traces, and commanded inspection are supplied; inference: resurrection publishes a causal archive from inward act to outward consequence; live alternative: the publication branch may be lexically remote and the book passages may concern revelation alone.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection restores living bodies after disappearance.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection also opens the retained record of hidden origins and embodied consequences, making what survived invisibly inspectable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condemned neither complete death nor obtain relief, then ask to exit and perform productive good after a lifespan sufficient for remembering. Mere continued existence is therefore not the life pictured by revived earth; that life is beneficial capacity to grow and act within a bounded cultivation interval.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life and power supplies more than the stopping of a biological clock.
Life as benefit and good supplies active generativity as the focus's positive state.
Dry growth revived by rain supplies a productive cycle rather than bare persistence.
The denied loss of life shows that non-death can coexist with a condition lacking beneficial life.
Completion and ending supply the terminal event that is withheld without producing life.
Lightening a load supplies the absent relief that distinguishes mere duration from flourishing.
Exit to an outside realm supplies the requested return to an arena of action.
A lifespan extended in time defines the finite interval in which productive response was possible.
Recovery from forgetfulness supplies the missed activation that should have occurred during that interval.

structural_cues: The first context verse suspends its subjects between death and relief; the next records their request for another action-cycle.
The focus's revived earth is visibly productive, making generativity an available criterion for life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: denied death, denied relief, requested exit, productive action, and sufficient lifespan are supplied; inference: focus-life denotes beneficial capacity within a cultivation window; live alternative: the infernal passage may only describe punishment and not refine the semantic content of earthly life.

changed_reading.before: To be alive is simply not to be dead.
changed_reading.after: The focus's life is active generativity and benefit; endless non-death without relief or action is a different state, and the productive interval is not endlessly repeatable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paradox of the focus sharpens: a radical state transformation from dead to living occurs through an invariant recurrent course that admits neither substitution nor diversion. Resurrection is not capricious novelty; it is the extraordinary outcome of a stable divine pattern.

activation_trace.role: Real loss of life supplies the starting state that makes the transformation radical.
Recurring rain-growth supplies an observable repeated course from death to life.
Revival of the dead extends the recurrent course to resurrection.
A running, followed path supplies the invariant course through which outcomes recur.
Alteration of a thing's form supplies the explicitly excluded mutation of the governing pattern.
Diversion from one state to another supplies the explicitly excluded deflection of that pattern.

structural_cues: The focus's comparison marker presents the observed rain process as a repeatable template for resurrection.
The later verse repeats the governing pattern three times and denies both substitution and diversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a repeated divine course and explicit denials of its replacement or diversion are supplied; inference: the focus comparison invokes this stable course as the warrant for a radical future transformation; live alternative: the invariant course may refer narrowly to historical judgment rather than natural quickening.

changed_reading.before: Rain is one illustrative miracle that makes resurrection imaginable.
changed_reading.after: Rain discloses an invariant divine pattern in which even the radical passage from death to life is regular in governance, though extraordinary to its recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate consequence is withheld so creatures remain on earth until a fixed term. The focus's dead interval can therefore be read as maintained latency rather than neglect: traces and recipients are left in place until the appointed activation and accounting arrive.

activation_trace.role: Dead land supplies a recipient that remains in place through an inactive interval.
After-versus-before ordering supplies a meaningful delay between death and activation.
Revival supplies the event that eventually terminates latency.
Acquired gain or consequence supplies what awaits eventual accounting during the delay.
Leaving a remainder or trace supplies preservation rather than annihilation during postponement.
Deferral to a later time supplies the causal pause before consequence.
A fixed terminal time supplies the boundary and purpose of the pause.

structural_cues: The final verse explicitly contrasts immediate seizure with preservation until a named term.
The focus marks destination and after-time before announcing resurrection, so its process already contains controlled delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: earned consequence, preservation, postponement, and a fixed term are supplied; inference: the dead interval in the focus is a governed latency that conserves recipients and traces for later activation; live alternative: the final delay concerns moral forbearance only and need not characterize physical death.

changed_reading.before: Death is an empty gap before revival.
changed_reading.after: The gap is timed latency: recipients and consequences are preserved under forbearance until the appointed activation and accounting.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus surface denotes winds, not a soul or spirit. It remains valid as a root-internal material analogy: the same focus root carries bodily life-breath and tree-leafing branches, while explicit land quickening and rain-revived herbage anchor the result. Downstream prose should call the wind breath-like and generative, never identify it literally with a resurrecting soul.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The wind root at word 4 stands immediately upstream of land-life at word 11 and resurrection at word 17.

activation_trace.role: The life-breath by which a body lives supplies the breath-like activation analogy.
Trees breaking into leaf and plants lengthening supply a vegetal bridge from moving air to visible life.
Rain-enabled life of earth supplies the explicit outcome that contains the breath analogy.
Rain reviving dry herbage joins breath-like motion to resurrection through plant unfolding.

changed_reading.before: Wind is only the mechanical force that moves cloud.
changed_reading.after: Wind can additionally function as a breath-like generative precursor whose movement anticipates the return of life and vegetal unfolding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain contrast is surprising because a cloud's transport and a person's moral burden are not the same kind of load. It remains anchored in the focus's drawn carrier and directed driving, while 35:18 explicitly denies transferring a heavy burden to another. Downstream prose should render it as a limiting foil: material mercy is distributable across places, but responsibility at resurrection is not transferable across persons.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 6-9 depict a carrier driven to another recipient, while the closing resurrection term makes the limits of transfer consequential.

activation_trace.role: A dragged and extended carrier supplies successful transfer of material benefit across space.
Directed driving supplies delivery to a recipient other than the point of origin.
Resurrection makes the distinction between conveyed life and retained responsibility eschatologically live.
A heavy burden supplies the moral load whose transfer is explicitly denied.
Being made heavy by a load supplies the strained would-be sender in the failed transfer.
Bearing an entrusted or culpable load specifies the non-transferable counterpart to the cloud's carried benefit.

changed_reading.before: The cloud's successful transport simply models how bodies or life are gathered for resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The transport also supplies a foil: life-giving material may be carried to another land, but resurrection gathers persons without moving one person's acquired burden onto another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because weather is not literally a prophetic speaker. It remains anchored in the identical sending root used for winds in the focus and for a messenger in 35:24, with good-news and warning branches giving the delivery contrasting meanings. Downstream prose should describe a functional, nonverbal messenger analogy: the weather event enacts and announces resurrection without turning wind into a prophet.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus begins by sending winds and ends by naming resurrection, giving the dispatched weather a demonstrative message-function.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch of wind supplies the concrete envoy-like movement.
Moving air supplies the nonverbal carrier that traverses the world.
Revival of the dead supplies the content demonstrated by the envoy-like weather.
A messenger carrying a message activates a communicative function latent in the focus's sending verb.
News that opens the face with joy supplies the revived land's good-news aspect.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the same resurrection sign's admonitory aspect.

changed_reading.before: The weather sequence is evidence from nature.
changed_reading.after: The dispatched weather can function as a nonverbal messenger whose enacted revival both gladdens with life and warns of resurrection.

strongest_changes: The natural relay became a controlled system of opening, holding, release, and permitted motion.
Staged same-substrate reassembly and continuity through replacement remained live as competing models rather than being merged.
One descending input producing differentiated forms changed revival from generic greening into individuation under a common cause.
Recurring records, hidden sources of action, and inspectable historical traces strengthened an exploratory resurrection-as-publication reading.
summary.what_was_special: The split mapping on the stirring root and the publication branch of the resurrection root became productive only when later books, hidden interiors, and earthbound traces converged; independently, a returning-water branch bent the focus's outward dispatch into a return circuit.
remaining_uncertainties: The trace and publication reading may reflect branch-distance rather than operative polysemy in this ayah.
The succession model may demonstrate replaceability by divine power without defining resurrected personal identity.
The perceptual and moral contrasts may refine life functionally without licensing a full metaphorical reading of dead land.
The breath-like and messenger readings should remain functional analogies, not claims about the literal identity of the winds.
